paragraphs: AI: "Google announces Gemini 4 flagship AI model after months of delays" (Reuters) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Google Releases a New Flagship A.I. Model, With Limits" (The New York Times).

Political: "Trump’s Voluntary A.I. Policing Echoes What Biden Did. But Is It Enough Today?" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Fed blasted by top watchdog over ‘mismanaged’ $2.5B ‘Palace of Versailles’ HQ work" (New York Post).

Economic: "Trump Tariffs Face Scrutiny in US Trade Court Over Legal Justification" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures edge lower ahead of PCE inflation data" (Yahoo Finance).

Financial: "Fed official used Asian dating site, sent nude photos — and wound up blackmailed by alleged Chinese spy" (New York Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Passengers Avert Crash Tackling Pilot Who Stabbed Colleague" (Bloomberg).

Geopolitical: "Live Updates: Plane to Israel Narrowly Averts Disaster After Pilot Stabbing" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "FlyDubai Flight to Israel Diverted After Clash Between Pilots: What We Know and Don’t Know" (The New York Times).
